company.shortDescription: Pravica is a blockchain infrastructure service provider.
company.description: Pravica is a blockchain infrastructure company focused on revolutionizing financial technology by bridging traditional finance with decentralized systems. Its vision is to drive global adoption of tokenized money through secure, scalable, and compliant platforms. Pravica’s flagship products, S3.Money and Walletify, enable seamless stablecoin issuance, management, and real-world transactions, empowering issuers, distributors, and end-users to thrive in the digital economy.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,008,868 to $4,658,011, a 1.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 15 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
